mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TIMER ( TIMER_ID , TARGET_TIME , OWNER_ID , IS_EXPIRED , CREATED_AT , UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{timerId}, #{targetTime}, #{ownerId}, #{isExpired}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )
